nodes.title: H3 Ref2VA Auto 编辑文本-H3剧本提示词
Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
10秒剧本

Theme: Q-version siblings' candied-hawthorn time

overall_soundscape: 
The cheerful ambience of an ancient Chinese street continues throughout — distant chatter, footsteps on stone pavement, and the wooden clatter of the candy vendor's stall. The little girl's running steps patter softly, her clothes rustle as she tugs at her brother, and a crisp crack rings out when she bites into the candied hawthorn, followed by a happy little giggle.

non_diegetic_music: 
A light, bouncy plucked-string theme on pipa and ukulele at a moderate tempo, joined by a gentle woodwind melody, staying playful and soft, then easing into a warm, cozy close at the end.

subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>Brother (Xiaofeng): A small 3D Q-style boy about 1.2 meters tall, brown hair, wearing blue clothes, a head taller than his sister.
<Picture 2>Sister (sugar): A little girl with pink powder blusher, wearing a pink skirt, a head shorter than her brother, the top of her head reaching about his shoulder.
<Picture 3>Scene: An ancient Chinese street with a tanghulu (candied hawthorn) stall.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] 3D CG, Q-version chibi anime style, bright and warm colors with soft subsurface-scattering materials on the skin and glossy candy coating. A medium-wide shot frames an ancient Chinese street in a Q-version setting, where a small brown-haired boy in blue clothes (S1) with a warm, gentle voice stands alone beside the tanghulu stall, holding a stick of candied hawthorn in his right hand — the vendor has just handed it to him, and the tanghulu is intact and uneaten. Xiao Tang, a little girl in a pink dress with rosy cheeks and pink blush (S2), runs into the frame from the right side with both hands empty, hops up and down, tugs at the boy's clothes, her lips moving clearly as she calls out: <d>[Chinese] 哥哥，哥哥，我要糖葫芦</d> Xiao Feng turns his head, gives a tender smile, his lips syncing to the words: <d>[Chinese] 好好好</d> Throughout the shot the girl's hands remain completely empty — she never touches or conjures the tanghulu, the boy never hands it to her, and he never eats it. Exaggerated, adorable expressions; warm sunlight floods the ancient Chinese street with traditional wooden architecture.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, Xiao Tang's eyes light up, she reaches out her empty hands, solemnly takes the tanghulu, opens her mouth wide and bites down, her cheeks puffing out as she sways happily and says in a sweet, slightly muffled voice: <d>[Chinese] 好甜</d> Xiao Feng keeps smiling, his lips syncing to the words in the same warm voice: <d>[Chinese] 小馋猫</d> The boy never eats the tanghulu himself, and the girl only receives it after he hands it to her — nothing appears out of thin air. The warm, cozy atmosphere keeps the ancient street softly blurred in the background.
